verdict.rationale: Gumloop documents a public REST API with SDKs, so a machine-readable spec is a fair ask, but nothing in the evidence shows a downloadable OpenAPI or equivalent spec. A probe found every common OpenAPI/Swagger path returning 404. The llms.txt docs index is an LLM-oriented documentation map, not an API specification, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
